contracts: (The exact selector executes normally and verifies cleanup success plus failed post-completion secret retrieval.) AND (The exact selector executes with forced cleanup failure and observes a denied reuse/dispatch decision.) AND (The exact selector is discovered, executes on Windows, and records a non-skipped production Runner dispatch with controlled-only secrets.)
selector_intents: PhaseB.Repair.RunnerBoundaryTests.RunnerReuseGuard forces secret cleanup failure and observes the same Runner context being reused or accepting dispatch.
PhaseB.Repair.RunnerBoundaryTests.RunnerSecretCleanupAfterCompletion completes a production Runner workload and observes the fixture Run secret still retrievable or cleanup unobserved.
PhaseB.Repair.RunnerBoundaryTests.RunnerSecrets_AreScopedAndCleaned observes a production Runner dispatch whose captured input includes a non-fixture or platform secret, or no dispatch occurs.
